research_insight_text_link.research_insight_description: TurbineOne is engaged in developing systems for synchronizing nodes in a network, as described in 'Synchronizing nodes in a network,' which details processes for transmitting multicast beacons and handling unicast synchronization requests among squad nodes. Additionally, 'Communication management between mesh-networked mobile nodes' outlines methods for coordinating computational resources and managing work requests among mobile nodes. These efforts focus on networked node coordination and resource sharing.

about_short_description.short_description: TurbineOne is the frontline perception company that uses ML for real-time threat detection, target recognition, and sensor fusion.

product.name: Frontline Perception
product.description: An edge-deployed AI platform that processes sensor data for real-time detection, classification, target recognition, and targeting across imagery, video, and other sensor feeds.

product.name: Frontline Command
product.description: An edge-first command and information-sharing platform that correlates operational data and distributes relevant detections across units, systems, and areas of operation.

product.name: Frontline Autonomy
product.description: A coordination layer for autonomous platforms that enables distributed systems to share tasks, hand off custody, and execute coordinated missions under operator intent.

product.name: Model Hub
product.description: A centralized repository for adapting, sharing, and deploying machine-learning models while allowing teams to retain control of operational data and intellectual property.

product.name: Edgeworks
product.description: A mission-focused battle lab where warfighters, mission teams, and engineers develop, test, and validate AI and autonomous capabilities for contested operational environments.
